summary: This standards-track document defines a YANG data model for Layer 3 network topologies. It extends the generic network topology model so that IP-level nodes, links and attributes can be described in a standard way.

eli5.summary: A basic map shows towns and roads. This adds the street addresses that matter for the internet's own routing level.
